The '''Ermi system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Sertar sector/Legends|Sertar sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ermi]], homeworld of the species of the [[Ermi (species)|same name]].
